risk_if_not_implemented: Without Documenting Data Processing Activities, Personal Data (PD) may be collected, processed, retained or shared without lawful authority or adequate safeguards, harming individuals and exposing the organization to regulatory action. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Unauthorized Retention / Inability to Dispose of Data (R-AM-3), Regulatory / Legal / Contractual Financial Liability (R-EX-5), Unaddressed Security / Compliance Exposure (R-GV-2), Inability to Demonstrate Due Diligence / Due Care (R-GV-9), Privacy Harm / Unauthorized Processing (R-IP-6), and most likely increases susceptibility to Human Error (MT-9), Statutory / Regulatory / Contractual Change (MT-11).

compensating_control_1.name: Sensitive / Regulated Data Governance
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate data governance so that sensitive and/or regulated data is effectively managed and maintained in accordance with applicable statutory, regulatory and contractual obligations.
compensating_control_1.justification: Sensitive / Regulated Data Governance (DCH-03) provides policy-level governance that compensates for the absence of Documenting Data Processing Activities (PRI-05) by establishing documented expectations, accountability structures, and organizational guardrails. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Statutory, Regulatory & Contractual Compliance
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the identification and implementation of relevant statutory, regulatory and contractual controls.
compensating_control_2.justification: Statutory, Regulatory & Contractual Compliance (CPL-02) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Documenting Data Processing Activities (PRI-05) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with Process applicability. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
